name: Toshishita-kun ni Semararetemasu!
original_name: 年下くんに迫られてます！
source:
After many failed dates you have become exhausted and decided to quit. Yet you still yearn for someone to spend time with. Unexpectedly you meet a man that fits your ideal type. However it turns out he is a High School Student. What do you do?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231001234937/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.interest.tsst]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在多次失败的约会之后，你已经精疲力尽并决定退出。但你仍然渴望有人陪伴。没想到你遇到了一个符合你理想型的男人。然而事实证明他是一名高中生。你做什么工作？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231001234937/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.interest.tsst]Google Play[/url]]
